instruction: Open https://power.larc.nasa.gov/data-access-viewer/ and use Single Point with Standard Resolution, Renewable Energy community and Daily temporal level. Request only Temperature at 2 Meters and All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance for latitude 42.36, longitude -71.1, from September 12 through September 13, 2025, in metric units and Local Solar Time (LST), as JSON. Leave optional custom site elevation unset; do not request adjusted pressure. Initiate the data request. A saved file is not required. These are NASA POWER environmental estimates, not a claim of direct station measurements.
